craft_notes: Sthāyin: urge-joy. Close: attained. Rejected: 'meditate' for jāgrad — killed: waking kept; 'soon' moved — kept? L4 'soon attained' — kept.

lines: Hence ever striving, spanda-reality to divide;
waking indeed, their own state soon attained.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ataḥ satatam udyuktaḥ spandatattvaviviktaye | jāgrad eva nijam bhāvam acireṇādhigacchati

reads_against.argmap: Hence ever striving for spanda-reality discerning: waking indeed, own state soon attains.
c1_essence: Ever striving, discerning spanda-reality; waking attains soon.
